title: Quality has gone down
text: Sadly the quality of these boxes has gone down. We’ve been getting these boxes for over a year and the past few months have been terrible! Stale crackers and cheap chocolates are all that they send now. The boxes also are delivered very late in the month now. I understand that it’s probably due to Covid related supply issues but have a little integrity and just don’t send a box until issues can be resolved!
label: negative
